card.name: Rows and steps inside dosing tables
card.fires_on: Small table-cell words, numbers and symbols in lists or charts, such as a unit, a dash, a roman numeral or a space between a dose and the next weight range. It sits right at a boundary between one row or item and the next.

modes.label: Weight and dose charts
modes.description: Spaces, dashes and units between weight ranges and daily doses in a dosing chart.

modes.label: Graded category tables
modes.description: Roman numerals or class numbers marking the next row in a skin-type or severity scale.
modes.example: 1.5 J/cm 2<< IV>> Never burn, always tan 2.

modes.label: Other list steps
modes.description: Words or commas that continue a series of counts or time points.
modes.example: Those with 75 repeats<< were>> normal for a month

card.plain: It marks the point in a chart or list where one row ends and the next begins.
